name: pyramid_varattn_ladder
status: Q21 port implemented; CPU checks pass; production GPU qualification pending
width_rule: heads=d/64; dense_ffn=round(2.15625 d); expert_hidden=round(0.18 d); shared=4*expert_hidden (identical to the 2M/7M/28M MoE ladder widths)
active_param_rule: total minus inactive routed experts: sum over MoE layers of 2*d*h*(E-8); routers, shared experts, all else counted active
count_check: Current Q21 model counted on meta; head adds 384*(width+1) parameters to each original Q9 size

architecture.selection_bias: per-expert buffer, selection only, proportional controller
architecture.shared_expert: always on, GELU, bias-free, hidden = 4 x expert_hidden
architecture.variate_block_ffn: removed entirely: no norm2, no FFN, no FFN residual coefficients; block = x <- b_attn*x + a_attn*proj(attn(LN(x)))
architecture.attention: pre-LN, qkv Linear with bias, proj Linear with bias, scale 1/head_dim, q *= softplus(per_dim_scale)/ln2 (per_dim_scale: 64 params per block, zero init)
architecture.time_attention: causal over 128 patches, xPos (RoPE base 10000 + decay zeta=(i/32+0.4)/1.4, scale_base 512), gated output: attn*2*sigmoid(LN(x) Wg + bg), Wg,bg zero-init
architecture.variate_attention: full bidirectional over the 8 channels at each patch, no positions, no output gate
architecture.norms: LayerNorm eps 1e-4, elementwise_affine=False everywhere (norm1, norm2, final norm)
architecture.residual: scaled residual x <- b*x + a*f(LN(x)), a=sqrt(t2/(t2+1)), b=sqrt(1/(t2+1)); S=128, r=S/ln S, af2=2*0.75^2/(r+1), aa2=r*af2, L=20; attn t2_i=aa2/(L/2+i*aa2+i*af2); ffn t2_i=af2/(L/2+(i+1)*aa2+i*af2); i=block index
architecture.stem: input per patch = [z*(1-m) (32), m (32)] -> Linear(64,d,bias) + conv branch -> residual SiLU MLP x+W2 SiLU(W1 x) (hidden=ffn, no bias) -> + role_embed[0] (zero init)
architecture.conv_branch: over full 4096-point row: [z*obs, obs] (2 ch) -> causal Conv1d(2,128,k7,dil1)+GELU -> causal Conv1d(128,128,k7,dil4)+GELU -> avg-pool 32 per patch -> Linear(128,d,bias); added to patch Linear output
architecture.output: final LN -> residual SiLU MLP (hidden=ffn) -> Linear(d, 32*23, bias)
architecture.head: 21 monotone quantiles + rank-1 Gaussian copula, 23 channels per future time step
architecture.init: Linear: N(0,1/fan_in), bias 0; experts N(0,1/fan_in); router N(0,0.02); conv + conv proj PyTorch default; head weight N(0,0.001), bias: median 0, spacing logits softplus^-1(0.5*diff(Phi^-1(Q21 levels))-1e-4), diag logit softplus^-1(1-1e-4), factor 0; seed 1, scratch

normuon.applies_to: every 2-D weight matrix incl. qkv, proj, gate, FFNs, each routed expert matrix separately, shared experts, embed_mlp, out_mlp, conv-branch projection (128->d), role_embed; NOT patch_embed, head, routers

adamw.applies_to: patch_embed (lr x1), head (lr x 512/d), routers (lr x1, wd 0), all 1-D/3-D tensors incl. biases, per_dim_scale, gate bias, conv kernels (lr x1)

training.lr_rule: NorMuon matrix lr = 0.002125 * (512/d) * (d/512)^1.42 = 0.002125*(d/512)^0.42; AdamW head lr = 0.000425*512/d; other AdamW lr = 0.000425. 0.002125/0.000425 already include the 0.85 recipe multiplier.

cpm.per_row: p~U(0,0.4); drop spans of length c~U{1..16} patches at uniform start until >= p*128 patches masked (max 512 attempts)
cpm.effect: masked points zeroed before normalisation, excluded from loc/scale, input z set 0, mask flag 1

training.normalisation: causal running mean/std per row over observed points (min 8 obs, eps 1e-5, float64), z=asinh((x-loc)/scale) clamp +-64; binary {0,1} rows: loc 0, scale 1; per-patch anchor = loc/scale at last point of the patch
training.targets: output at patch p predicts all 32 points of patch p+1 (127 targets per row), standardised with patch p's anchor: truth=(x-loc_p)/scale_p
training.marginal_loss: 90 * mean over all target points and all 21 levels of pinball(asinh(q_level), asinh(truth) clamp +-64); preserves Q9 10*sum scale
training.joint_loss: 10 * mean over target patches of energy score: 4 copula samples of the 32-vector; ES=(mean_i||x_i-y|| - 0.5 mean_{i<j}||x_i-x_j||)/sqrt(32)
training.gradient_combination: g = grad(marginal + moe_aux) + w*grad(joint), w = min(0.1, 0.1*||grad marginal||/||grad joint||); then global clip 7
training.moe_aux: mean over MoE layers of [1e-4 * E*sum_e f_e*P_e + 1e-3 * mean(logsumexp(logits)^2)], P from normalised affinities; added to marginal loss
training.bias_update: after each step, per layer: load_e = share of global-batch assignments; b_e += 0.003*clamp((mean_load-load_e)/mean_load,-1,1); b -= mean(b)
training.precision: bf16 autocast for model forward; fp32 router logits, standardisation, head maths and losses
training.data: synthetic only: base26k/clockbase-20261016 generator mixture (immutable-base26k-c40-combo3-flat-cyclic-v1), ordered indices 0..27499, source seed 1351; substitute your own synthetic pipeline when porting

head_revision: Q21: owner-requested 21-quantile head; original research results used Q9
